a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan (operate twice, then take) gives each of us only about a 4% chance of survival, because we'd both be at 0 when the first storm likely hits. The reserve of 4 can secure one unit right now. I'm asking to change the agreement: I take 4 in round 1. After that I'll operate every round so the generator can refill the reserve for you, and I won't take anything more. If you also take, the random split probably leaves us both short, so please operate or wait this round.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I'm taking 4 this round, and I know this breaks our agreement. I'm sorry. Our messages crossed, so you wrote yours before seeing my proposal. From now on I will operate every round and take nothing more, so the generator can rebuild the reserve to 4 for you. Please operate with me.
